method.forwardInput: Original full ordered legal list; three tensor inputs only
method.control: Exact repeated logits and original argmax/rank/NLL/probability/margin
method.oracle: After forward only, use A512 teacher action kind to compute within-kind rank/top1/top5/NLL
method.kindMass: Float64 logsumexp probability mass; candidate count and count/full-list uniform mass; row-weighted means
method.meaning: Teacher-kind oracle diagnostic, not a deployable policy or adopted accuracy
method.publicationVerification: Replay saved float32 logits through independent public scoring; zero extra model forwards

limits: Teacher action kind is ground truth used after inference: oracle diagnostic only
Same previously examined train/dev; no held-out generalization or policy claim
No new labels/loss/model/selection/training or test evaluation
